industrialBase.overview: Virellia possesses one of the world's largest and most capable industrial bases, with particularly strong domestic capacity in shipbuilding, aerospace manufacturing, heavy machinery, electronics, energy systems, and vehicle production.

production.electronicsSemiconductors: $348.9 billion VD; Virellia is the world's largest producer, accounting for 65%–68% of global production.
production.railLocomotives: 1,985 rail locomotives and 2.9 million tons of steel.

defenseProduction.overview: Virellia maintains a broad domestic defense-production base spanning combat aviation, naval construction, armored and support vehicles, missile systems, munitions, soldier equipment, electronics, and space systems. Annual output varies by procurement demand, operational conditions, and global security requirements.

aviation.smallDrones: 36,000–40,000 drones yearly, excluding large unmanned aircraft.

groundSystems.artillery: 1,095–1,132 rocket, towed, and self-propelled artillery systems yearly.

munitionsSoldierSystems.soldierEquipment: 11,000,000–34,000,000 units yearly, including helmets, armor, night-vision systems, optics, uniforms, and load-bearing equipment.

spaceElectronics.electronics: 34,000–49,000 systems yearly, including AESA radars, electronic-warfare systems, radios, datalinks, computers, and sensors.

economicScale.scoreScaleNote: Trade-volume scores use a 0–100 scale. Higher scores indicate greater export or import activity.
economicScale.currencyStrength: Global reserve currency used worldwide as an accepted medium of exchange. It is the tenth most valuable currency in terms of unit value.
